meta.solver: quasi-static daily driver (aging.run_years, exact for piecewise-constant segments); LSODA (model.run) for L2 TTE

calibration.note: mean_g is the RMS of g(z) over C0 (q_cal/(k_c sqrt(1000 d)))

soh_grid.note: aged(RP63, q_loss = 1 - SOH) with r_growth = gamma_R q_loss; S4 = constant social feed (SO) cold-soaked (T0 = T_amb); S12 from 07:00 at 25 °C; S13 = Dynkin mean of the typical CTMC (L0)

winter_threshold.note: illustrative threshold: SOH at which the S4 shutdown happens at >= 5 % displayed (linear interpolation on the SOH grid)

A1.label: charge to 100 %, held overnight
A1.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A2.label: 80 % charge limit
A2.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A3.label: optimised charging (hold 80 %, finish 1 h before unplug)
A3.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A4.label: hot climate, T_amb = 35 °C
A4.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A5.label: 2 h/day at 45 °C (car dashboard), otherwise A1
A5.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A6a.label: fast charge: CC 1.5C to 80 %
A6a.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A6b.label: charging in a 0 °C room at 1C (not JEITA-compliant)
A6b.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A6c.label: charging in a 0 °C room at 0.5C (JEITA rule)
A6c.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

A7.label: 1 FCE/day (heavy user, ΔSOC 0.95)
A7.years_to_80_note: None = SOH stays above 0.80 for the 3-year horizon

uq.note: years_to_80 quantiles: None = beyond the 3-year horizon. Calibration fixes SOH(1000 FCE, C0) = 0.8 in every sample, so the spread reflects conditions that differ from C0 (temperature, SOC, rate).
